iRule(1)						BIG-IP TMSH Manual						  iRule(1)

ANTIFRAUD::result
       Returns result of login validation (passed or failed).

SYNOPSIS
       ANTIFRAUD::result

DESCRIPTION
       Returns result of login validation (passed or failed).

RETURN VALUE
       Returns result of login validation (passed or failed).

VALID DURING
       ANTIFRAUD_LOGIN

EXAMPLES
	when ANTIFRAUD_LOGIN {
	    log local0. "Username tried to log in with result [ANTIFRAUD::result]."
	}

HINTS
SEE ALSO
CHANGE LOG
       @BIGIP-13.0.0
		   --First introduced the command.

BIG-IP							    2022-04-12							  iRule(1)
